rust_summary: Whether an incoming mob effect is applicable (`native_mob_effect_applicable`).
doc_summary: Before an effect is added, `native_mob_effect_applicable(entity, effect, source, result)` may set `result` to `Some(true)` to apply or `Some(false)` to reject; `None` leaves the vanilla decision. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mob_effect_applicable@.
